does_not_supersede: plan/protocol-v5.json remains the frozen campaign protocol. This successor does not reopen historical measurements, change recorded verdicts, or authorize an acceptance claim.
reason: check_results_v3.quality validates every per-item WER and then returns the independently supplied seed_tts_content_error_mean. Regressed per-item scores plus a stale lower aggregate can therefore yield quality_gate=PASS. This successor closes that gate defect. It does not treat the defect as evidence that a retained historical verdict was wrong.

quality_gate.disagreement: reject when the supplied seed_tts_content_error_mean disagrees with that mean, using the same close tolerance as other raw/aggregate checks (rel_tol=1e-6, abs_tol=1e-6)
quality_gate.paired_comparison: compare the reconciled means; a candidate mean greater than the baseline mean is a WER regression
quality_gate.unchanged_from_v3: coverage, failure counters, utterance identity, scorer manifest identity, and performance summarize checks
